title: Dodging Russian Drones On Ukrainian Road To Frontline Druzhkivka
content: RFE/RL joins Ukraine’s 93rd Mechanized Brigade on a dangerous route to Druzhkivka where Russian drones target vehicles and troops. Only a few thousand civilians remain inside the battered frontline city as Russian bombs devastate homes and Ukrainian forces hold the line.

title: An Arctic Traffic Jam Highlights Doubts Over Russia's Northern Sea Route To China

title: American Stephen Hubbard Freed After More Than 4 Years In Russian Custody
content: Russia has released 74-year-old US citizen Stephen Hubbard, who had been detained since 2022. He had been sentenced to prison for allegedly acting as a mercenary in Ukraine, charges his family disputed. President Vladimir Putin announced Hubbard’s release during talks with US envoy Steve Witkoff.

title: Amid Russia's Onslaught, A Twist In The Pursuit Of Men Fleeing Ukraine For Moldova
content: A viral video of two Ukrainian border guards’ violent pursuit of a man trying to cross the Dniester River into Moldova has highlighted a route Ukrainians use to escape Russia’s war and the prospect of fighting in it. title: Wounded Ukrainian Soldier Rescued From Front Lines By Aerial Drone

title: After Taliban Opium Ban, New Global Hub Emerges In Afghan Borderlands With Iran, Pakistan
